description_en: Updates the global TTL configuration of a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数更新GTM3.0 实例全局TTL配置
kebab_example: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-instance-config-basic --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --config-id Config-0000000 --schedule-zone-name example.com --schedule-hostname www --ttl 60 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCloudGtmInstanceConfigBasic

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GTM 3.0 instance that you want to modify
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the domain name instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This results in two domain name instance configurations for the same GTM instance. The ConfigId uniquely identifies the configuration object that you want to modify.

Call the [ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs~~) operation to query the ConfigId of a domain name instance
parameters.help_zh:
域名实例配置ID，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置。标识本次修改的配置对象。

调用[ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs~~)接口可查询域名实例对应的ConfigId值
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The root domain (such as example.com) or subdomain (such as a.example.com) of the GTM access domain name. This is usually a domain name that is hosted in the authoritative zone of the Alibaba Cloud DNS console under the account that owns the GTM instance
parameters.help_zh: GTM接入域名的主域（example.com）或子域（a.example.com）。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台权威解析中托管的域名
parameters.name: schedule_zone_name

parameters.help_en: The host record of the GTM access domain name
parameters.name: schedule_hostname

parameters.help_en: The global Time to Live (TTL) in seconds. This is the TTL for the DNS record that resolves the access domain name to an address in an address pool. The TTL affects how long the DNS record is cached on a carrier's Local DNS server
parameters.help_zh: 全局TTL（单位：秒），接入域名解析到地址池中地址的TTL值，影响解析记录在运营商LocalDNS中的缓存时间
parameters.name: ttl

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
本次操作是否成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
